source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 15 (PDF 25-56), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Human Nervous System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 In humans, chemical coordination is controlled by the:
(Insanon mein chemical coordination (kimiyai rabta) kaun sa system control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insanon mein do qisam ka coordination hai: nervous coordination (nervous system) aur chemical coordination (endocrine system).

book_ref.quote: Chemical coordination controlled by the endocrine system

blocks.prompt:
2 Nervous coordination is carried out by means of:
(Nervous coordination kis cheez ke zariye hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nervous coordination mein nervous system electrical signals (barqi ishaaron) ke zariye kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Nervous coordination is done by means of electrical signals

blocks.prompt:
3 Receptors are called transducers because they:
(Receptors ko transducers kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: energy ki aik shakal ko doosri shakal mein badalte hain

blocks.explanation: Receptors energy ki aik shakal ko doosri mein badalte hain, maslan retina ke rods aur cones roshni ki energy ko nerve impulse mein badalte hain.

book_ref.quote: Receptors act as transducers because they convert one form of energy into another form

blocks.prompt:
4 The brain and spinal cord are made of which neurons that process incoming impulses?
(Brain aur spinal cord kin neurons se bane hain jo aane wale impulses par amal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: CNS associative neurons (inter-neurons) se bana hai jo sensory neurons se impulses le kar un par amal karte hain.

book_ref.quote: These parts are made of associative neurons (also called inter-neurons)

blocks.prompt:
5 Glands act as effectors by:
(Glands effectors ke tor par kaise jawab dete hain?)

options.text: mahol ki tabdeeli mehsoos kar ke

blocks.explanation: Muscles sukar kar jawab dete hain jab ke glands ratoobat (secretion) bana kar.

book_ref.quote: Muscles produce response by contracting while glands produce secretion

blocks.prompt:
6 The structural and functional unit of the nervous system is the:
(Nervous system ki banawati aur kaam ki ikaai kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neuron (nerve cell) nervous system ki banawati aur kaam ki ikaai hai.

book_ref.quote: A neuron is the structural and functional unit of nervous system

blocks.prompt:
7 Which cells supply nutrients to neurons, remove wastes and provide immunity?
(Kaun se cells neurons ko ghiza dete, fuzla hatate aur immunity (madafiat) dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nervous system ke madadgar cells, neuroglia ya glial cells, yeh kaam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: They supply nutrients to neurons, remove wastes, and provide immunity

blocks.prompt:
8 The myelin sheath around axons in the central nervous system is produced by:
(Central nervous system mein axons ke gird myelin sheath kaun banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Peripheral nervous system mein Schwann cells aur CNS mein oligodendrocytes myelin banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Oligodendrocytes produce myelin sheath in central nervous system

blocks.prompt:
9 In myelinated neurons, nodes of Ranvier occur at intervals of about:
(Myelinated neurons mein nodes of Ranvier taqreeban kitne faasle par hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Myelin sheath har 1 se 2 mm ke baad chhote khali hisson se toot-ti hai jinhein nodes of Ranvier kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: the myelin sheath is interrupted at intervals of 1 to 2 mm by small gaps

blocks.prompt:
10 In the CNS, white matter is made of:
(CNS mein white matter kis cheez se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CNS mein myelinated axons white matter banate hain; non-myelinated dendrites aur cell bodies grey matter.

book_ref.quote: In the CNS, myelinated axons make white matter

blocks.prompt:
11 Nissl's granules in the cell body of a neuron are groups of:
(Neuron ki cell body mein Nissl's granules kis cheez ke group hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cell body ke cytoplasm mein Nissl's granules hote hain jo ribosomes aur rough ER ke group hain.

book_ref.quote: These are group of ribosomes and rough endoplasmic reticulum

blocks.prompt:
12 Motor neurons and inter-neurons have highly branched dendrites because they:
(Motor aur inter-neurons ke dendrites bohat shaakhdar kyun hote hain?)

options.text: aik waqt mein kai jagahon se impulses lete hain
impulse cell body se door le jate hain

blocks.explanation: Motor aur inter-neurons aik waqt mein kai jagahon se impulses lete hain, is liye un ke dendrites bohat shaakhdar hain.

book_ref.quote: That is why, they possess highly branched dendrites

blocks.prompt:
13 The axons controlling the muscles of human feet can be:
(Insani paon ke muscles control karne wale axons kitne lambe ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paon ke muscles control karne wale axons aik meter se zyada lambe hote hain (giraffe mein taqreeban teen meter).

book_ref.quote: the axons controlling the muscles in your feet are more than a meter long

blocks.prompt:
14 The end of an axon that may contact a muscle cell, gland cell or another neuron is the:
(Axon ka woh sira jo muscle cell, gland cell ya doosre neuron se rabta karta hai kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Axon ka sira axon terminal kehlata hai; yeh muscle cell, gland cell ya doosre neuron se rabta kar sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: The end of an axon is called the axon terminal

blocks.prompt:
15 The cell bodies of sensory neurons are located:
(Sensory neurons ki cell bodies kahan hoti hain?)

options.text: spinal cord ke grey matter mein

blocks.explanation: Sensory neurons ki cell bodies CNS se bahar ganglia naam ke guchhon mein hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Their cell bodies are located outside of the CNS in the form of clusters called ganglia

blocks.prompt:
16 Motor neurons are described as:
(Motor neurons ko kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Motor neurons multipolar hain: un ke bohat se dendrites hote hain jo mazeed shaakhon mein bat-te hain.

book_ref.quote: They are multipolar. It means that they have many dendrites

blocks.prompt:
17 Which neurons occur entirely within the CNS?
(Kaun se neurons poori tarah CNS ke andar hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Inter-neurons (associative neurons) poori tarah CNS ke andar hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Inter-neurons (associative neurons) occur entirely within the CNS

blocks.prompt:
18 Inter-neurons with short axons:
(Chhote axon wale inter-neurons kya karte hain?)

options.text: qareeb ke neurons se circuit bana kar chhoti maloomat parakhte hain
brain aur spinal cord ke door ke hisse jorte hain
impulses effectors tak le jate hain
receptors ko CNS se jorte hain

blocks.explanation: Chhote axon wale inter-neurons qareeb ke neurons se circuit banate hain; lambe axon wale brain aur spinal cord ke mukhtalif hisson ko jorte hain.

book_ref.quote: Some inter-neurons have short axons and form circuits with nearby neurons

blocks.prompt:
19 The simplest neural pathway in the nervous system is the:
(Nervous system ka sab se saada neural raasta kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reflex arc sab se saada neural raasta hai; yeh foran, khud-ba-khud aur ghair iradi jawab control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The reflex arc is the simplest neural pathway

blocks.prompt:
20 In the knee-jerk reflex, the stimulus (tapping) is sensed by a receptor present in the:
(Knee-jerk reflex mein thapki ko kaun sa receptor mehsoos karta hai, woh kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Patellar tendon par thapki ko ran (thigh) ke quadriceps muscle mein mojood receptor mehsoos karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This stimulus (tapping) is sensed by a receptor present in the quadriceps muscle of thigh

blocks.prompt:
21 In the knee-jerk reflex, the sensory neuron passes the impulse to the motor neuron of quadriceps:
(Knee-jerk reflex mein sensory neuron quadriceps ke motor neuron ko impulse kaise deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spinal cord mein sensory neuron inter-neuron ke baghair seedha motor neuron ko impulse deta hai.

book_ref.quote: the sensory neuron transfers the impulse to a motor neuron without involving an inter-neuron

blocks.prompt:
22 During the knee-jerk, the hamstrings muscle:
(Knee-jerk ke dauran hamstrings muscle ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: sensory neuron se seedha uksaya jata hai
dheela hota hai kyun ke inter-neuron us ke motor neurons ko rokta hai

blocks.explanation: Sensory neuron aik inter-neuron ko bhi chalata hai jo hamstrings ke motor neurons ko rokta hai, is liye hamstrings dheele ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: It results in the relaxation of hamstrings during the extension of the lower leg

blocks.prompt:
23 A wave of electrochemical changes travelling along the length of a neuron is a:
(Neuron ki lambai mein chalne wali electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki lehar kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nerve impulse electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki lehar hai jo neuron ki lambai mein chalti hai.

book_ref.quote: A nerve impulse is defined as a wave of electrochemical changes

blocks.prompt:
24 The membrane potentials of which cells can change because they can change the rates of ion movement?
(Kin cells ki membrane potential badal sakti hai kyun ke woh ions ki harkat ki raftar badal sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aksar cells mein ions ki harkat yaksan hai; muscle cells aur neurons ise badal sakte hain, is liye un ki membrane potential badalti hai.

book_ref.quote: the cell membranes of muscle and neurons can change the rates of ions movements

blocks.text: 15.3.1 Generation and Transmission of Nerve Impulse

blocks.prompt:
25 The resting membrane potential of a neuron is about:
(Neuron ki resting membrane potential taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polarized neuron ki RMP taqreeban –70 millivolts hai; manfi nishan batata hai ke andar bahar ke muqable mein manfi hai.

book_ref.quote: it is about –70 millivolts (–70 mV)

blocks.prompt:
26 In a resting neuron, the concentration of K⁺ inside compared with outside is about:
(Resting neuron mein K⁺ ki miqdar andar bahar ke muqable mein kitni guna hai?)
blocks.explanation: K⁺ andar 30 guna zyada hai; Na⁺ bahar 10 guna zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: The concentration of K⁺ is 30 times greater inside the neuron than outside

blocks.prompt:
27 In each cycle, the sodium-potassium pump moves:
(Sodium-potassium pump har dafa kya muntaqil karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har do K⁺ andar le jane par teen Na⁺ bahar nikale jate hain, is liye andar zyada manfi ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: For every two K⁺ that are actively transported inward, three Na⁺ are pumped out

blocks.prompt:
28 Large negatively charged molecules such as proteins and nucleic acids that cannot diffuse out of a neuron are called:
(Proteins aur nucleic acids jaise bare manfi molecules jo neuron se bahar nahi nikal sakte, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh bare manfi molecules andar zyada hain aur bahar nahi ja sakte; inhein fixed anions kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: These molecules are called fixed anions

blocks.prompt:
29 During depolarization, the membrane potential changes from –70 mV towards zero and then reaches about:
(Depolarization mein membrane potential –70 mV se zero ki taraf ja kar kitne tak pohanchti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Na⁺ tezi se andar aate hain; potential –70 mV se zero ki taraf ja kar 50 mV tak pohanchti hai.

book_ref.quote: towards zero and then reaches to 50 mV

blocks.prompt:
30 Depolarization produces an action potential on a short region of a neuron for about:
(Depolarization neuron ke chhote hisse par action potential kitni der ke liye banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kisi hisse par action potential taqreeban aik millisecond rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: This depolarization produces action potential on a short region of neuron for about one millisecond

blocks.prompt:
31 Repolarization of the neuron membrane occurs when:
(Neuron ki membrane ki repolarization kab hoti hai?)

options.text: Na⁺ gates khulte hain aur Na⁺ andar aata hai
Na⁺ gates band aur K⁺ gates khulte hain, K⁺ bahar jata hai
Cl⁻ channels khulte hain aur Cl⁻ andar aata hai
Ca²⁺ gates khulte hain aur Ca²⁺ andar aata hai

blocks.explanation: Depolarization ke baad Na⁺ gates band aur K⁺ gates khulte hain; K⁺ bahar jata hai aur andar phir manfi ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Na⁺ gates close and the K⁺ gates open

blocks.prompt:
32 Hyperpolarization of a neuron is due to:
(Neuron ki hyperpolarization ki wajah kya hai?)

options.text: tamam K⁺ gates band hone mein thori dair

blocks.explanation: Hyperpolarization (RMP se thora zyada manfi) tamam K⁺ gates ke band hone mein thori dair ki wajah se hai.

book_ref.quote: It is due to the slight delay in closing all the K⁺ gates

blocks.prompt:
33 After the refractory period, the original ionic distribution of the neuron is restored by:
(Refractory period ke baad neuron ki asal ionic taqseem kaun bahal karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium-potassium pump asal ionic taqseem bahal karta hai aur membrane RMP (–70 mV) par wapas aa jati hai.

book_ref.quote: original ionic distribution is restored by sodium-potassium pump

blocks.prompt:
34 An action potential moves along an axon because:
(Action potential axon par aage kyun barhti hai?)

options.text: wohi ions aik sire se doosre tak behte hain
har action potential agle hisse ko depolarize karti hai jo apni action potential banata hai
myelin sheath ise le jati hai
neurotransmitters axon ke andar safar karte hain

blocks.explanation: Action potentials dobara bante hain: aik hisse ki action potential agle hisse ke liye depolarization ka stimulus hai.

book_ref.quote: An action potential in a region of axon serves as a depolarization stimulus for the next region

blocks.prompt:
35 Along the length of an axon, the amplitude of action potentials:
(Axon ki lambai mein action potentials ki taqat (amplitude) kaisi rehti hai?)

options.text: nodes par zero ho jati hai

blocks.explanation: Axon ke aakhir mein action potential utni hi taqatwar hai jitni pehli; sirf raftar badal sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: The strength (amplitude) of action potentials remains constant along the length of axon

blocks.prompt:
36 In humans, non-myelinated neurons conduct impulses at a speed of:
(Insanon mein non-myelinated neurons kis raftar se impulse le jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Non-myelinated neurons 1 se 3 m/s par; myelinated neurons 120 m/s tak.

book_ref.quote: the non-myelinated neurons conduct impulses at speed of 1 to 3 metres per second

blocks.prompt:
37 Myelinated neurons in humans conduct impulses at speeds of up to:
(Insanon mein myelinated neurons kitni raftar tak impulse le jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Myelinated neurons 120 meter fi second tak ki raftar se impulse le jate hain.

book_ref.quote: the myelinated neurons conduct at speeds of up to 120 meters per second

blocks.prompt:
38 Saltatory conduction is faster than conduction in the fastest non-myelinated axons by up to:
(Saltatory conduction sab se tez non-myelinated axons se kitni guna tak tez hai?)
blocks.explanation: Saltatory conduction sab se tez non-myelinated axons se 50 guna tak tez hai.

book_ref.quote: It is up to 50 times faster than the nerve impulse through the fastest non-myelinated axons

blocks.prompt:
39 The fluid-filled gap between two neurons at a synapse is the:
(Synapse par do neurons ke darmiyan maye se bhara khala kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synapse par dono cells seedha nahi milte; darmiyan maye se bhara khala hota hai jise synaptic cleft kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: there is a fluid-filled gap between them, called a synaptic cleft

blocks.prompt:
40 The synapse between a motor neuron and a muscle fibre is called:
(Motor neuron aur muscle fibre ke darmiyan synapse ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Motor neuron aur muscle fibre ke synapse ko neuro-muscular junction bhi kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: The synapse between a motor neuron and a muscle fibre is also called neuro-muscular junction

blocks.prompt:
41 The neuron whose axon carries action potentials towards a synapse is the:
(Woh neuron jis ka axon action potentials synapse ki taraf le jata hai kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synapse ki taraf action potential bhejne wala neuron presynaptic hai; doosri taraf wala cell postsynaptic.

book_ref.quote: The neuron whose axon transmits action potentials towards synapse is the presynaptic neuron

blocks.prompt:
42 Synaptic vesicles in the synaptic knobs are packed with:
(Synaptic knobs ki synaptic vesicles mein kya bhara hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synaptic knobs mein bohat si synaptic vesicles hoti hain jin mein neurotransmitters bhare hote hain.

book_ref.quote: These knobs contain numerous synaptic vesicles which are packed with chemicals called neurotransmitters

blocks.prompt:
43 Neurotransmitters are released from synaptic vesicles by:
(Neurotransmitters synaptic vesicles se kis tareeqe se nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vesicles presynaptic membrane se jur kar exocytosis ke zariye neurotransmitters nikalti hain.

book_ref.quote: This fusion causes the release of neurotransmitters from vesicles by exocytosis

blocks.prompt:
44 The amount of neurotransmitter released at a synapse increases when:
(Synapse par neurotransmitter ki miqdar kab barhti hai?)

options.text: postsynaptic cell ke receptors kam hon
presynaptic axon mein action potentials ki frequency barh jaye

blocks.explanation: Presynaptic axon mein action potentials jitni zyada baar aayen, utna zyada neurotransmitter nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The higher the frequency of action potentials in the presynaptic axon, the more neurotransmitters are released

blocks.prompt:
45 After their action, used neurotransmitters are removed from the synaptic cleft by:
(Kaam ke baad istemal shuda neurotransmitters synaptic cleft se kaise hataye jate hain?)

options.text: cleft mein hamesha ke liye jama rehna
presynaptic neuron ka wapas jazb karna ya enzymes se toot jana

blocks.explanation: Kai synapses par istemal shuda neurotransmitters presynaptic neuron wapas jazb kar leta hai; doosron par enzymes inhein tor dete hain.

book_ref.quote: At other synapses, they are broken down by enzymes

blocks.prompt:
46 Excitatory neurotransmitters generate action potentials in postsynaptic neurons by increasing membrane permeability to:
(Excitatory neurotransmitters postsynaptic neuron ki membrane ko kis ion ke liye zyada guzarne wala banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Excitatory neurotransmitters membrane ki Na⁺ ke liye guzar-gahi barha kar nerve impulse banate hain.

book_ref.quote: by increasing membrane permeability to Na⁺

blocks.prompt:
47 Which excitatory neurotransmitter is mentioned as acting in the CNS?
(Kaun sa excitatory neurotransmitter CNS mein kaam karta bataya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glutamate CNS mein kaam karne wala excitatory neurotransmitter hai; glycine, GABA aur endorphins inhibitory hain.

book_ref.quote: Glutamate acts in the CNS.

blocks.prompt:
48 Degeneration of which neurons produces the muscle tremors of Parkinson's disease?
(Kin neurons ki kharabi se Parkinson's disease mein muscles kaanpte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dopamine nikalne wale neurons ki kharabi Parkinson's disease ke kaanpte muscles ki wajah hai.

book_ref.quote: Degeneration of dopamine-releasing neurons produces the muscle tremors of Parkinson’s disease

blocks.prompt:
49 Many antidepressant drugs reduce depression by:
(Bohat si antidepressant dawaen depression kaise kam karti hain?)

options.text: serotonin ko synaptic cleft se khatam hone se rok kar

blocks.explanation: Serotonin ki kam sargarmi depression la sakti hai; antidepressants serotonin ko cleft se hatne nahi dete.

book_ref.quote: Many antidepressant drugs block the elimination of serotonin from the synaptic cleft

blocks.prompt:
50 Which biogenic amine, made in the CNS and sympathetic nerves, regulates sleep patterns, focus and alertness?
(Kaun sa biogenic amine, jo CNS aur sympathetic nerves mein banta hai, neend, tawajjuh aur chaukasi ko control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Norepinephrine CNS aur sympathetic nerves mein banta hai aur neend, tawajjuh aur chaukasi control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It regulates sleep patterns, focus and alertness

blocks.prompt:
51 The brain neurotransmitter that controls body movements and pleasures related to motivation is:
(Dimagh ka woh neurotransmitter jo jism ki harkat aur motivation se juri khushi control karta hai:)
blocks.explanation: Dopamine jism ki harkat, motivation wali khushi aur jazbati uksahat control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It controls body movements, pleasures related to motivation and also emotional stimulation

blocks.prompt:
52 When an inhibitory neurotransmitter binds to the postsynaptic receptors, which channels open?
(Jab inhibitory neurotransmitter postsynaptic receptors se jurta hai to kaun se channels khulte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sodium ki jagah chloride channels khulte hain; Cl⁻ andar aa kar andar ko RMP se zyada manfi kar deta hai.

book_ref.quote: channels for chloride ions open instead of opening sodium channels

blocks.prompt:
53 The chief inhibitory neurotransmitter in the CNS is:
(CNS ka sab se ahem inhibitory neurotransmitter kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA) CNS ka sab se ahem inhibitory neurotransmitter hai; yeh bechaini kam aur neend paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: is the chief inhibitory neurotransmitter in CNS

blocks.prompt:
54 Glycine acts as an inhibitory neurotransmitter especially in the:
(Glycine khaas tor par kahan inhibitory neurotransmitter ka kaam karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycine khaas tor par spinal cord, brainstem aur retina mein inhibitory hai.

book_ref.quote: Glycine is an inhibitory neurotransmitter especially in the spinal cord, brainstem, and retina

blocks.prompt:
55 Many sedative drugs work by:
(Bohat si sukoon-awar (sedative) dawaen kaise kaam karti hain?)

options.text: GABA ko us ke receptors se zyada jor kar

blocks.explanation: Bohat si sedative dawaen GABA ko us ke receptors se zyada jorti hain, is tarah synapse par GABA ka asar barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Many sedative drugs enhance the binding of GABA to its receptors

blocks.prompt:
56 Opium, morphine and heroin have an analgesic effect because they are chemically similar to:
(Opium, morphine aur heroin dard kam kyun karte hain? Woh kis se kimiyai tor par milte julte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh kimiyai banawat mein endorphins jaise hain aur endorphin receptors se asani se jur jate hain.

book_ref.quote: because they are similar in chemical structure to endorphins

blocks.prompt:
57 Nerve gases such as sarin, tabun and soman are toxic because they inhibit:
(Sarin, tabun aur soman jaisi nerve gases kis cheez ko rok kar zehreeli hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nerve gas acetylcholinesterase ko rokti hai, is liye acetylcholine jama ho kar skeletal muscles ko sukra rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: A nerve gas (e.g., sarin, tabun, soman) is a highly toxic chemical that inhibits this enzyme

blocks.prompt:
58 In nerve gas poisoning, breathing stops mainly because:
(Nerve gas zeher mein saans mainly kyun ruk jati hai?)

options.text: phephre chloride se bhar jate hain
GABA nikalna band ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Jama acetylcholine muscles ko sukra rakhta hai; agar diaphragm sukra rahe to insan saans nahi le sakta.

book_ref.quote: If the diaphragm muscle remains contracted, the person is not be able to breathe

blocks.text: 15.5 Basic organization of human nervous system

blocks.prompt:
59 The peripheral nervous system consists of:
(Peripheral nervous system kis cheez par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: PNS cranial aur spinal nerves par mushtamil hai jo brain aur spinal cord se nikalti hain.

book_ref.quote: The PNS consists of cranial and spinal nerves

blocks.text: 15.5.1 Central Nervous System - Brain & Spinal Cord

blocks.prompt:
60 The outermost thick layer of the meninges that contains larger blood vessels is the:
(Meninges ki sab se bahar wali moti teh jis mein bari khoon ki naliyan hain:)
blocks.explanation: Dura mater, khopri aur vertebrae ke neeche, sab se bahar ki moti teh hai jis mein bari khoon ki naliyan hain.

book_ref.quote: It contains larger blood vessels.

blocks.prompt:
61 The meningeal layer that acts as a barrier between cerebrospinal fluid and the blood of the dura mater is the:
(Meninges ki woh teh jo cerebrospinal fluid aur dura mater ke khoon ke darmiyan rukawat hai:)
blocks.explanation: Patli arachnoid dura mater ke neeche hai aur apne neeche ke CSF ko dura mater ke khoon se alag rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: It acts as a barrier between the cerebrospinal fluid present below it and the blood in the dura mater

blocks.prompt:
62 The average adult human brain weighs about:
(Aik baligh insan ka dimagh ausatan kitna wazni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik baligh insan ka dimagh ausatan 1.4 kg hai, jism ke wazan ka taqreeban 2 feesad.

book_ref.quote: The average adult human brain weighs 1.4 kg (about 2 percent of total body weight)

blocks.prompt:
63 The two cerebral hemispheres are connected at the base of the deep groove by the:
(Dono cerebral hemispheres gehri naali ki tah mein kis se jure hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gehri naali ki tah mein dono hemispheres corpus callosum (axons ki patti) se jure hain.

book_ref.quote: both cerebral hemispheres are connected by the corpus callosum (a band of axons)

blocks.prompt:
64 Damage to the left cerebral hemisphere would cause loss of sensation and paralysis on the:
(Baen cerebral hemisphere ko nuqsan se hiss ka khatma aur falij kis taraf hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf ka kaam karta hai, is liye aik ke nuqsan se mukhalif taraf mutasir hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Damage to one hemisphere results in a loss of sensation and paralysis on the opposite side of body

blocks.prompt:
65 Executive functions such as self-control, planning, reasoning and abstract thought are associated with the:
(Khud par qaboo, mansooba bandi, dalail aur mujarrad soch jaise kaam kis lobe se mutalliq hain?)
blocks.explanation: Frontal lobes khud par qaboo, mansooba bandi, dalail aur mujarrad soch se mutalliq hain.

book_ref.quote: The frontal lobes are associated with executive functions

blocks.prompt:
66 Vision is controlled by the:
(Nazar (vision) ko kaun sa lobe control karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Occipital lobes nazar control karte hain; visual cortex occipital lobe mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The occipital lobes control vision.

blocks.prompt:
67 The auditory cortex, which deals with different sound frequencies, lies in the:
(Auditory cortex jo awaaz ki mukhtalif frequencies se nimatta hai, kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: Auditory cortex temporal lobe mein hai; visual cortex occipital lobe mein.

book_ref.quote: A specialized area called auditory cortex within the temporal lobe deals with different sound frequencies

blocks.prompt:
68 A shallow groove separating gyri of the cerebral hemispheres is called a:
(Cerebral hemispheres mein gyri ko alag karne wali kam gehri naali kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ubhar gyri hain; kam gehri naali sulcus aur gehri naali fissure hai.

book_ref.quote: A shallow groove is called sulcus (plural, sulci) and a deep groove is called fissure

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
74 The part of the diencephalon that regulates body temperature, hunger and thirst and controls the pituitary gland is the:

77 The consolidation of information from short-term to long-term memory involves the:

78 The part of the brain that processes information about body position and controls posture is the:

(Dimagh ke ventricles ka asal kaam kya hai?)

blocks.prompt:

83 The central canal of the spinal cord is a continuation of the:

blocks.explanation: Pehle do jore (olfactory aur optic) cerebrum se, baqi 10 jore brainstem se nikalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
91 The number of pairs of thoracic spinal nerves is:

92 The number of pairs of cervical spinal nerves is:

blocks.explanation: Cervical nerves ke 8 jore hain.

shaoori control ke baghair kaam karta hai

(Sympathetic nervous system ka jild ki khoon ki naliyon par kya asar hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table: Effects of Autonomic Nervous System on Body Parts

blocks.prompt:

olfactory bulb tak pohanchne ke baad

sirf andaruni aza par asar karta hai

blocks.prompt:

(Kaun sa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: Tamam narcotics psychoactive hain, magar har psychoactive drug narcotic nahi

blocks.explanation: Tamam narcotics psychoactive hain, magar tamam psychoactive drugs narcotics nahi.

book_ref.quote: All narcotics are psychoactive drugs, but all psychoactive drugs are not narcotics

118 Nicotine produces pleasurable feelings by causing release of:

wapas jazb karne wale receptors zyada bana deta hai

options.text: presynaptic neuron ke dopamine wapas jazb karne wale receptors band kar ke

options.text: Is mein X-rays istemal hoti hain

Is mein taqatwar magnetic field istemal hota hai
Is ke liye general anaesthesia zaroori hai
